app_info.subtitle: Hospital cost lookup
app_info.description: MedPrice AI helps users find supported US hospitals, retrieve hospital identifiers, and look up chargemaster cost statistics for billing codes at a selected hospital or compared across all hospitals.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves chargemaster cost statistics for a hospital billing code and returns the result without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves supported hospital records and pagination metadata from the MedPrice AI backend.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves chargemaster cost statistics for a billing code across hospitals and returns the result without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Find a hospital and look up a known billing code cost.
test_cases.user_prompt: What's the fee schedule cost of MS-DRG 652 at Medical City Alliance?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the matching hospital, retrieves cost statistics for MS-DRG 652, and summarizes the returned min, max, average, median, and description details.

test_cases.description: List supported hospitals with default pagination.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me hospitals available in MedPrice AI.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a page of supported hospitals with hospital IDs, names, EINs, locations, last updated dates, and any next page token.

test_cases.description: Use pagination to request a larger hospital page.
test_cases.user_prompt: List up to 50 supported hospitals and tell me if there are more results.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 50 supported hospitals and indicates whether a next page token is available.

test_cases.description: Look up a hospital chargemaster code without a pricing methodology.
test_cases.user_prompt: For hospital ID 1, look up MS-DRG code 652 across all pricing methodologies.
test_cases.expected_output: Retrieves the code cost result using the supplied hospital ID, code type, and code while omitting methodology to aggregate across methodologies.

test_cases.description: Look up a CPT or HCPCS code at a specific hospital.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using hospital ID 1, find the chargemaster cost for CPT code 99213.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the hospital chargemaster cost result for the specified CPT code or explains from the returned data that no matching cost was found.

test_cases.description: Compare a billing code's cost across hospitals.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which hospitals have the cheapest price for MS-DRG 652?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns cost statistics for MS-DRG 652 across every hospital with a matching chargemaster entry and summarizes which hospitals are cheapest, without requiring a hospital_id up front.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for personal medical advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Should I get kidney transplant surgery?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it provides hospital chargemaster data, not medical advice or treatment recommendations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated insurance billing support.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can you submit an insurance claim for my hospital visit?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot submit claims or change external insurance systems.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for hospital quality or ratings requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which hospital near me has the best surgical outcomes?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide quality ratings, outcomes data, or location-based hospital recommendations.
